column3: But It's A Denpa Song
No, that's why I said this is nothing more than a denp-
Don't say denpa...!
--Guu?!
I really won't forgive you if you say denpa a second time.
Y-You should say that only if you had forgiven me at least once before...
Hmph, the fact that you're such a senseless fool is the reason why this is such a pain.
Heck, that song makes no sense. And I'm the one who's strange?
Or maybe it's a godly piece of music for those who like that kind of stuff?
...No good, I don't get it at all.
But why did you suddenly compose this piece again?
That's because this song I've composed could very well be the main theme song for this Summer Comiket!
Huh? Why would your song become the main theme of such a large event?
Could that be what Nico Nico Douga was advertising about?
Exactly!
Nico Nico Douga... That website that hosts all kinds of videos?
Why is it also requesting songs?
Due to the influence of Vocaloids, tons of quality songs have been composed by users.
It's likely due to that.
S-So that's how it is...
The world has left me behind and kept on moving!
Hehe～
The truth is... I have already submitted my application!
Oh. However, you merely submitted your application, right? It's not like you have been selected-
There is no way this godly piece of music won't be selected!
...Huh.
Isn't it great?! Isn't it terrific even?!
I don't think there's a chance for this denpa song to be selected...
But just where does that vitality come from?
You gotta admire her enthusiasm when it comes to the stuff she likes.
...Hehe.
Ah, that Kuroneko...
That condescending smile... Could it be...
Huh? Hey, what are you chuckling about?
No, nothing really.
You were thinking there's no way my song could be selected, right?
Oh? Could it be that you're thinking that way too since you said it yourself?
Obviously not. Are you jealous of my multiple talents?
...Even if you're talented, your future will be nothing if you continue to bask in self-satisfaction.
Huh? What are you saying?
Well, calm down, both of you.
Quiet, you should help me say something.
*sigh* Don't they ever get tired of this?
Kuroneko, could you try listening to it just once first?
Why must I go to that extent?
Do it for me, please?
......I guess there's no helping it, just a little then.
Hehe～! Listen to my godly song!
Kuroneko put on the earphones.
How is it, how is it? The song I made! It's the best, isn't it?!
Isn't it good? Very good? Extraordinary?
The godly song has appeared! Maybe I'll embed it into my 【laptop】 system sound when I get home!
...What's with this song?
Hah?! Do you have problems with your ears?
Hey hey hey! Don't start fighting here, alright?
Once you interfere the conversation becomes complicated, so keep quiet.
...Did I say anything wrong?
Kiririn-shi and Kuroneko-shi are having something similar to a lover's quarrel. It's better to stay quiet and watch until it all settles down.
...Guess so. *sigh*...
